description: This file defines the ProjectActivity entity class for an HRM system, including properties such as id, project, deletion status, name, and related timesheet items. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ProjectActivity
classes.description: Entity class representing a project activity with relationships to project and timesheet items, including properties for id, project, name, deletion status, and associated timesheet entries.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the project activity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the project activity.

methods.name: setProject
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with this activity.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the project activity is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the project activity as deleted or active.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the project activity.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the project activity.
